QUOTE: A build through an outdated process would run old pipeline logic and re-stamp the index with it, dropping layers. `stale_code_refusal` (`freshness.py`) refuses writes in that case
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the build/write side but never states that reads stay current because query tools open the database per call; it even implies replies may be affected, so the asymmetry is absent.
